facts.text: The hotel is a revival of the historic Blackstone Hotel, which dates to 1916.
facts.excerpt: a revival of the historic Blackstone Hotel, an Omaha icon dating to 1916

facts.text: The hotel is set in the revitalized Blackstone District, a short drive from downtown Omaha.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Cottonwood Hotel is set in the revitalized Blackstone District, just a short drive to downtown.

facts.text: The hotel has a steakhouse, The Committee Chophouse, with an interactive dessert menu.
facts.excerpt: Be sure to explore our interactive dessert menu, offering a creative and immersive way to indulge your sweet tooth.

facts.text: The Cottonwood Room is a cocktail bar on the lower level of the hotel with a speakeasy feel.
facts.excerpt: Located in the lower level of The Cottonwood Hotel, guests will enjoy an elevated speakeasy feel

facts.text: Orleans Room serves a menu built on seasonally changing, locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Rotating seasons play host to ever-changing, locally sourced ingredients

facts.text: Petit Orleans serves cappuccino and pastries.
facts.excerpt: Serving a mean cappuccino and delicious pastries to fuel whatever the day brings.

facts.text: The hotel displays a locally curated art collection in its common areas.
facts.excerpt: enjoy our locally curated art collection throughout airy and light-filled common areas

facts.text: The outdoor pool deck has loungers, rentable cabanas and a hot tub.
facts.excerpt: The expansive deck is complete with loungers, rentable cabanas, shaded seating areas for cooling off on summer nights and a relaxing hot tub.

facts.text: The Cottonwood Pool Club is open seasonally from early May to mid-September.
facts.excerpt: The Cottonwood Pool Club is open seasonally from early-May thru mid-September.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes pets of any size, weight or breed at no extra charge.
facts.excerpt: no matter their size, weight, or breed, all at no extra charge.

facts.text: The hotel offers bike cruisers for guests to explore nearby museums and parks.
facts.excerpt: take one of our bike cruisers to explore nearby museums and parks.

facts.text: Valet parking is offered to overnight guests, and the parking facility is off-site.
facts.excerpt: Valet Parking offered to overnight at $37, event at $15, and restaurant/lounge guests at $10.

facts.text: The hotel has no local area shuttle.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.
